description: This file contains mock implementations and helper functions for GSSAPI-related testing within the Chromium project, including classes for GSS name and context mocking, and functions for managing GSS buffers and OIDs.

classes.name: GssNameMockImpl
classes.description: Mock implementation of GSSAPI name object, holding name string and type.

classes.name: GssContextMockImpl
classes.description: Mock implementation of GSSAPI security context, holding context details such as source and target names, lifetime, mechanism type, flags, and state.

classes.name: MockGSSAPILibrary
classes.description: Mock class simulating GSSAPI library functions for testing, including context initialization, name handling, and status display.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns values from another GssContextMockImpl instance.

methods.name: ExpectSecurityContext
methods.description: Sets expectations for security context negotiation in the mock library.

methods.name: import_name
methods.description: Mocks importing a GSSAPI name from a buffer.

methods.name: display_status
methods.description: Mocks displaying a GSSAPI status message.

methods.name: wrap_size_limit
methods.description: Mocks calculating wrap size limit, intentionally fails.

methods.name: inquire_context
methods.description: Mocks inquiring about a security context.

methods.name: GetLibraryNameForTesting
methods.description: Returns the name of the mock GSS library.
